text:
kai: Heads-up — saw a weird p95 spike in matrix batching when ctx >= 8192 on the int4 path. Batch=16 only, batch=8 is fine. reproducible on c6d-24. 

marta: ugh. any chance it's KV cache churn or backend GC? :thinking_face:

devon: can you paste the exact perf run? also which kernel set/torch build?

kai: ran: `runtest --model orion-14b-int4 --ctx 8192 --batch 16 --profile --kernels=auto`

kai: profiler summary (p95 latency window):
```
model: orion-14b-int4
hw: c6d-24
batch: 16
ctx: 8192
rpc p50 68.2ms p95 1.23s p99 2.8s
observed taily stalls ~1s every ~30s
mem: gpu 97% alloc, cpu RSS steady
logs: frequent `kv_cache_miss` followed by `realloc` spikes
```

perf-bot: Attached flamegraph: https://perf.redwood.internal/attaches/1719204567/flame.svg :eyes:

sophia: that pattern screams allocator fragmentation to me. int4 kernel path uses pinned buffers + staging, might be failing to reuse pages at large ctx lengths.

marta: we saw something similar on veritas14b but at ctx 6144. solution there was to force a different allocator config: `TORCH_ALLOCATOR=jemalloc_shm` and limit staging to 4GB. worth trying.

devon: can we try a quick A/B? (1) rerun with `--kernels=legacy` and (2) rerun with `TORCH_ALLOCATOR=jemalloc_shm` and `--staging-limit=4g`

kai: starting (1) now. will attach logs. ETA ~12m.

kai: small log excerpt after (1): `p95 74ms`, no long stalls for 20m. looks much better.

sophia: ok that isolates it to the new kernel autotuner path or kernel selection heuristics for large ctx.

marta: still want to check CPU side: RPC queue growth? can someone run `rpc-stats` on the node during a reproduce?

devon: on it. `rpc-stats` shows queue depth spikes aligning with the p95 stalls, and those align with large mem reallocs in the logs.

kai: hypothesis: kernel selector picks a different attention kernel that allocates transient workspace per batch item, which at ctx 8k x batch16 tears the allocator and forces blocking reclaims.

sophia: plan: 1) add failover to legacy kernels for ctx >= 4096 until we patch selector; 2) reproduce with the autotuner in a debug build to log kernel choices; 3) run a stress with synthetic trace to get deterministic repro.

marta: +1. also add a short perf test to Dedicated CI that hits batch 16 x ctx 8192 on orion-14b-int4 so we don't regress again.

devon: i'll open an issue with reproducer steps and raw traces, tag runtime and kernel teams. assigning to @sophia to lead mitigation (legacy failover + selector fix).

sophia: taking it. I'll have a quick mitigation PR (legacy failover) by EOD. if we need temporary doc, i'll drop a note in eng-runtime.

kai: thanks. leaving the flamegraph and raw logs in the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2248

perf-bot: Test run summary uploaded: /artifacts/INF-2248/1719204567/

marta: follow-up: once mitigated, let's run a ctx sweep (2048, 4096, 6144, 8192, 10240) x batch sizes (8, 16, 32) and record p50/p95/p99 heatmap. add to model onboarding checklist.

devon: agreed. also include memory high-water mark and allocator churn counters in the report.

kai: noted. will add results to the onboarding intake for orion-14b-int4.

sophia: quick note — if anyone needs to reproduce locally, set `STAGING_LIMIT=4g` to avoid immediate OOM while testing.

marta: :thumbsup: thanks all. closing here until PR lands.
